narr: A complex of storms that moved along the Minnesota/Iowa border surged northeast and began to train across south central Minnesota. Initially, large hail occurred south of Mankato, and around Owatonna. After the initial hail, training of the storms allowed for very heavy rainfall to occur between Waseca and Owatonna. Locally, 2.80 inches of rain fell around Waseca in less than three hours, and a few roads in the city of Owatonna were covered in water.
ev: Very heavy rainfall occurred in a short period of time in the city of Owatonna. There were a few streets that had water covering the roadway and were impassable at one point. These roads included the intersection of Elm and Main Street, and Rose and Elm Street on the east side of town.
